elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: New 10.9: "Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall exceed..." — the cap runs to both Parties, and no retained language leaves Company liability unlimited.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000)" — matches basis (fees paid or payable, not broader 'all amounts'), the 12-month pre-claim lookback, and the USD 1,000,000 floor.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: "and neither Party shall be liable for any indirect or consequential damages" — expressed bilaterally in the same sentence.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: "'Excluded Claims' means a Party's breach of its confidentiality... obligations", and the cap opens "Except for Excluded Claims".

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims expressly includes breach of "data protection or security obligations".

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims includes "its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights".

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: "The Company's payment obligations under this Agreement, comprising all amounts due to HDI hereunder, are not damages subject to such cap." The carve-out is anchored to all amounts due, not a narrow defined subset of Fees, so no illusory-definition problem arises.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Same bilateral "neither Party's total aggregate liability" formulation in 10.9.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Cap limb (a) is "fees paid or payable by the Company... in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim".
"indemnification obligations" sit inside the Excluded Claims definition carved out of the cap.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: "breach of its confidentiality... obligations" is an Excluded Claim.

reasons: The document genuinely lacks any limitation-of-liability, aggregate-cap or consequential-damages language (Sections 9 and 10 as cited contain none), so the 'missing' classification and a concise inserted clause are appropriate; all words being new does not defeat minimality for a missing clause.

Every preferred element is delivered in operative text: mutual cap, greater-of formula with 'fees paid or payable' and the twelve-month pre-claim lookback plus the USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, and the full Excluded Claims list (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other Party's IP).

The Customer-payment carve-out resolves its own scope ('comprising all amounts due to HDI hereunder') rather than relying on an undefined or narrow 'Fees' term, so it covers Company payment obligations as a whole; this scoping is required to make the element operative and is not a gratuitous example.

No extras were added: no survival tail (the drafter relies on the existing Section 10.7 survival rather than duplicating it), no procedures, notice mechanics, additional damages categories or at-own-expense language, and no existing wording was deleted or paraphrased.

Intent is preserved: the insertion as new Section 10.9 creates no dangling cross-reference, 'Excluded Claims' is defined within the same clause, and nothing in Sections 1-10.8 is contradicted or displaced.
Position-complete at the preferred level; no repair needed.
